trust_decision.summary: A model-stored string must never be concatenated or passed through into a form field's help_text, because help_text is rendered with |safe; the safe patterns already in tree are format_html() for plain interpolation and render_markdown() (markdown -> nh3 clean_html) for rich text. The decision sits at render time in the form/model code that builds the field, not at write time in the serializer.

landing_point.why: The report says 'object create/edit form help text'; the only form class in the tree that assigns a database value into help_text is ModuleForm.__init__ (an f-string over parent_bay.module_family.name at dcim/forms.py:2691-2693), reached from the Module add/edit views (nautobot/dcim/views.py:3936-3940) with ?parent_module_bay=<pk> seeding initial (nautobot/core/views/generic.py:559).

fix_sites.entry_point: Every object create/edit view through RelationshipModelFormMixin (nautobot/extras/forms/mixins.py:523), every bulk-edit view through RelationshipModelBulkEditFormMixin (nautobot/extras/forms/mixins.py:288), and every list filter form through RelationshipModelFilterFormMixin (nautobot/extras/forms/mixins.py:743) call Relationship.to_form_field().
Module add/edit UI, e.g. /dcim/modules/add/?parent_module_bay=<pk> and /dcim/modules/<pk>/edit/, via ModuleUIViewSet.form_class (nautobot/dcim/views.py:3936-3940).
Relationship add/edit UI form RelationshipForm (description field + markdown help_text added by the fix; description already listed in Meta at nautobot/extras/forms/forms.py:2315).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue the second site is a different feature, not form help text: Relationship description is author-supplied rich text belonging to the relationships feature, while the report's example was a plain model name in a plain-sentence help text, so the example is read as the full list of affected paths.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
help_text is intentionally rendered as raw HTML (|safe), so legitimate static help texts carry //
    /
    markup; and Relationship/CustomField descriptions intentionally render Markdown plus a limited HTML subset. A fix that escapes help_text at the template layer, or escapes/strips descriptions at input time, breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: plain HTML tags inside a short unique model name (ModuleFamily.name, unique CharField at nautobot/dcim/models/devices.py:1756) interpolated into a fixed help-text sentence
arbitrary HTML or a Markdown+HTML mixture inside a long free-text field (Relationship.description, nautobot/extras/models/relationships.py:610)
value written by the REST API as well as by the UI form, i.e. stored state reloaded later by the form
